headlines.title: 富国银行：美联储通常在加息/降息概率超过69%时才会行动
headlines.summary: 根据富国银行汇编的自2015年以来的数据，美联储传统上会在加息或降息的概率升至69%以上时才采取行动。该银行表示，周五公布的消费者物价指数（CPI）数据“很可能决定”央行在下周会议上的决策。 由Ohsung Kwon领衔的分析师在周二发布的报告中写道：“自2015年以来，加息或降息的概率从未落在38%-69%的区间内，而当市场对会议的定价超过69%时，美联储每次都采取了行动。”

headlines.title_en: Wells Fargo: Fed typically acts when odds of rate hike/cut exceed 69%
headlines.summary_en: Based on data compiled by Wells Fargo since 2015, the Federal Reserve has traditionally acted only when the probability of a rate hike or cut rises above 69%. The bank said Friday's CPI data will 'likely determine' the central bank's decision at next week's meeting. Analysts led by Ohsung Kwon wrote in a report released Tuesday: 'Since 2015, the probability of a rate hike or cut has never fallen within the 38%-69% range, and when market pricing for a meeting exceeded 69%, the Fed acted every time.'

headlines.title: 江波龙：首次回购公司A股股份124.95万股 耗资4.48亿元
headlines.summary: 江波龙公告称，公司此前审议通过回购股份方案，拟使用4.00亿元-8.00亿元自有或自筹资金，以集中竞价方式回购股份用于股权激励或员工持股计划，回购价格不超过735.00元/股，回购期限为董事会审议通过之日起12个月内。2026年9月8日，公司首次以集中竞价方式回购A股股份124.9455万股，占公司A股总股本的0.29%，最高成交价365.38元/股，最低成交价353.52元/股，成交总金额4.48亿元（不含交易费用）。公司后续将根据市场情况在回购期限内继续实施回购方案。

headlines.title_en: Longsys: First buyback of 1.2495 million A-shares, spending 448 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Longsys announced that its board previously approved a share buyback plan to repurchase shares via centralized bidding for equity incentives or employee stock ownership plans, using 400 million to 800 million yuan of its own or self-raised funds, at a price not exceeding 735.00 yuan per share, within 12 months from board approval. On September 8, 2026, the company repurchased 1,249,455 A-shares for the first time via centralized bidding, accounting for 0.29% of total A-shares, with highest transaction price of 365.38 yuan/share and lowest of 353.52 yuan/share, totaling 448 million yuan (excluding transaction fees). The company will continue implementing the buyback plan based on market conditions within the buyback period.

Brent crude nears $100! Houthis strike deep inland, targeting Saudi energy facilities. According to Kyodo News, the Bank of Japan plans to raise interest rates to 1.25% at its September meeting. The Hormuz crisis unexpectedly 'revived' the Suez Canal: July revenue surged 42% to a two-and-a-half-year high. According to Bloomberg, Zimbabwe suspended antimony and tungsten exports. Not enough to control OPEC oil? Reports: U.S. sets sights on gold and other mineral resources.
